entries.back_en: "Thou art the one who claims to be a god?"

"Thou art not a god. Thou art but a mere shadow...Something that hath drunk of the dregs of divine power and believes that thus thou becomest a god. Thou wast affected by our power and that of the others; nothing more."
"Perhaps...Perhaps the world doth not need gods? What sayest thou?"

"The Endless are summoned to this world...This changes the very balance of Nature, flooding the cosmos with powerful and dangerous energies, and makes beings easily influenced believe themselves gods..."
